[1/6] Plan: host-lockdown failure consequence, near-miss bonus attempts, extraction-surge push-your-luck, deterministic save/puzzle persistence, terminal-state safety, docs+ADR

impact_assessment.why: Mechanics audit: (a) a burned hacking puzzle can be retried immediately and for free, so failure has no cost and puzzles are an infinite free-roll; (b) near-miss feedback is cosmetic (and add_trace inflates the near-miss counter), so the strongest addictivity cue carries no mechanical meaning; (c) jackout is guaranteed from any breached node, so the push-your-luck loop has no late-extraction risk and trace above 60 only pressures the player into a guaranteed bank; (d) save/load reseeds the RNG to seed+turns, rerolling reward rolls, and pending puzzle attempts are not persisted, enabling deterministic save-scumming; (e) several actions award rewards or report success after their own world tick has already triggered lockout.
impact_assessment.benefits: Failure becomes a tactical cost that makes downtime and other hosts matter; near misses convert into a capped, memorable extra attempt; extraction at high trace becomes a real final gamble that rewards disciplined banking; save/load becomes trustworthy and non-exploitable; action outcomes stop contradicting the terminal state. Together these tighten the addiction loop around risk, recovery, and loss aversion.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: Node and savegame gain additive fields only; API puzzle solve response may gain near_miss_bonus/lockdown fields; existing tests expecting RNG reseeding change behavior; dependency: none (stdlib only); concurrency: server already serializes under a session RLock; state: Node.lockdown_until_turn/failed_attempts and persisted rng/puzzles need backward-compatible defaults and atomic-save integration
impact_assessment.mitigation: Additive dataclass defaults, explicit old-save fallback, failing-first unit/integration/API tests, centralized failure handler shared by CLI and Web, full unittest discover plus aikit check after every milestone, and ADR-019 documenting each balance change with quantitative bands.

checkpoints.description: [2/6] Failure consequence + near-miss payoff: Node.failed_attempts/lockdown_until_turn, register_puzzle_failure centralizes escalating trace (+4 per stack, cap 30), EDR alert, combo break, 2-turn host ICE lockdown shared by CLI/Web; first near miss per puzzle grants one bonus attempt/retry via resolve_puzzle_near_miss, Web buffer bay keeps the puzzle open on a bonus; 246 tests green; checklists: passed

impact_assessment.why: The core risk loop was one-sided: burned puzzles were free retries and near misses were cosmetic.
impact_assessment.benefits: Detected failures now cost tempo, trace, and combo; near misses convert into a capped comeback that reinforces the re-engagement cue without making puzzles trivial.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: additive Node fields only; old saves default to unlocked hosts; API adds near_miss_bonus; dependency: none
impact_assessment.mitigation: Failing-first unit/API tests, centralized handler used by both surfaces, full discover after each milestone.
